name: CreateFile

parameters.help_en:
The processing mode for files with the same name. Valid values:

ignore: Allows files with the same name.

auto_rename: Automatically renames the file on the cloud when a file with the same name is found. By default, the current timestamp is appended, such as xxx_20060102_150405.

refuse: Rejects the creation of the new file and returns the details of the existing file with the same name to the client when a file with the same name exists on the cloud.

Default value: ignore
parameters.help_zh:
同名文件处理模式，可选值如下：

ignore：允许同名文件；

auto_rename：当发现同名文件是，云端自动重命名，默认为追加当前时间点，如 xxx _20060102_150405；

refuse：当云端存在同名文件时，拒绝创建新文件，返回客户端已存在同名文件的详细信息。

默认为 ignore
parameters.name: check_name_mode

parameters.help_en: The hash value of the file content. It must be calculated based on the algorithm specified by content_hash_name
parameters.help_zh: 文件内容 hash 值，需要根据 content_hash_name 指定的算法计算
parameters.name: content_hash

parameters.help_en: The name of the hash algorithm used for the file content. Currently, only SHA-1 is supported
parameters.help_zh: 文件内容hash算法名，当前只支持 sha1
parameters.name: content_hash_name

parameters.help_en: The content type of the file. Default value: application/octet-stream.<props="china"> For common content types, refer to the OSS documentation How do I set Content-Type (MIME)? (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39522.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5a0b7dbb1TPnWF#concept-5041).</props>
parameters.help_zh: 文件内容类型，默认值 application/oct-stream<props="china">，常见的 content_type 可以参考 OSS 《如何设置Content-Type（MIME）？》 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39522.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5a0b7dbb1TPnWF#concept-5041)。</props>
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the file. The maximum length is 1,024 characters. Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: 文件描述信息，最长 1024 字符，默认为空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The drive ID. This parameter is required unless the file is uploaded through a sharing link
parameters.help_zh: 空间 id，除通过分享链接上传之外，必填
parameters.name: drive_id

parameters.help_en: The file ID. This parameter is required when overwriting an existing file
parameters.help_zh: 文件id，覆盖写时必填
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to hide the file. By default, the file is not hidden
parameters.help_zh: 是否隐藏，默认不隐藏
parameters.name: hidden

parameters.help_en: The local creation time of the file. Default value: empty. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time is in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 文件本地创建时间，默认为空，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，采用 UTC +0 时区
parameters.name: local_created_at

parameters.help_en: The local modification time of the file. Default value: empty. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time is in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 文件本地修改时间，默认为空，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，采用 UTC +0 时区
parameters.name: local_modified_at

parameters.help_en: The file name. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes when encoded in UTF-8. It cannot contain a forward slash (/)
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称，按照 utf8 编码最长 1024 字节，不能包含 /
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable concurrent multipart upload
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启并行上传分片功能
parameters.name: parallel_upload

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder. Set this parameter to root when uploading to the root directory
parameters.help_zh: 父目录id，上传到根目录时填写 root
parameters.name: parent_file_id

fields.help_en: The MD5 hash of the part. This parameter is required when you need to verify the MD5 hash of the part during the upload
fields.help_zh: 分片的 MD5, 需要在上传分片时校验分片的MD5时填写
fields.name: content_md5

fields.help_en: The Content-Type value that the client must set when using the PUT method to upload the part. If the Content-Type specified by the client during the upload does not match this value, a signature error occurs. Default value: empty. The client does not need to specify Content-Type when using the PUT method
fields.help_zh:
指定客户端使用 Put 上传分片时需要设置的 Content-Type 值。
如果客户端上传时指定的 Content-Type 和这里不一致，会出现签名错误。
默认为空，客户端 Put 时可以不指定 Content-Type
fields.name: content_type

fields.help_en: The first to fifth 32-bit variables of the SHA-1 contextual of all data before this part. This field is valid only in the concurrent multipart upload pattern
fields.help_zh: 该分片前所有数据的SHA1上下文的第1-5个32位变量，该字段只在多分片并发上传的模式下有效
fields.name: h

fields.help_en: The total length in bytes up to the previous data block. The value must be a multiple of 64. This field is valid only in concurrent multipart upload mode
fields.help_zh: 到上一个数据块为止的总长度，字节，需要为64的倍数，该字段只在多分片并发上传的模式下有效
fields.name: part_offset

fields.help_en: The SHA-1 context of all data before this part. This field is valid only in concurrent multipart upload mode
fields.help_zh: 该分片前所有数据的SHA1上下文，该字段只在多分片并发上传的模式下有效
fields.name: parallel_sha1_ctx

fields.help_zh: 分片序列号，从 1 开始
fields.name: part_number

parameters.help_en: The list of part information. A maximum of 10,000 parts are supported. If this parameter is not specified, one part is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 分片信息列表，最多 10000 个分片，当不填时，默认返回 1 个分片
parameters.name: part_info_list

parameters.help_en: The SHA-1 hash value of the first 1 KB of the file. This parameter is used for the pre-instant upload feature. If no match is found on the server, the client does not need to calculate the complete SHA-1 hash of the file to attempt an instant upload
parameters.help_zh: 使用预秒传功能时填写，为文件前1KB sha1值，当远端没有匹配上时，客户端无需再计算文件完整 sha1 去尝试秒传
parameters.name: pre_hash

parameters.help_en: The share ID. This parameter is required when the file is uploaded through a sharing link
parameters.help_zh: 分享 id，当通过分享链接上传时必填
parameters.name: share_id

parameters.help_en: The file size, in bytes
parameters.help_zh: 文件大小，单位为 byte
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
The file type. Valid values:

file: file
folder: folder
parameters.help_zh:
文件类型，可选值如下：

file：文件
folder：文件夹
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The upload type. Valid values: multipart and form. Default value: multipart
parameters.help_zh: 上传类型，支持 multipart，form，默认：multipart
parameters.name: upload_type

fields.help_en: The key. It cannot be empty or contain the number sign (#). The total length of the key and value in a single element cannot exceed 2,000 bytes
fields.help_zh: key，不能为空，不能包含 #。单个元素中的 key 和 value 总长度不能超过 2000 字节
fields.name: key

parameters.help_en: The custom user tags. A maximum of 1,000 tags are supported
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义 tag，最多 1000 个 tag
parameters.name: user_tags

parent_file_id.description_en: The ID of the parent folder

v1_parameters.help_zh: 域 ID，唯一标识一个域（Domain），作为业务访问地址 {domain_id}.api.aliyunpds.com 中的域标识
